subject: executor,distsql: refactor the base executor in tableReader (#51397)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent (1fc91d46f8e00aff91cb11fc66bd79be7b47a401). The change cleanly splits `BaseExecutor` into `BaseExecutorV2` + session-backed wrapper, introduces `distsql/context.DistSQLContext` to remove full `sessionctx.Context` dependency in DistSQL paths, and refactors `TableReaderExecutor` to carry only the needed DistSQL/plan/expr contexts while updating virtual column evaluation to use `expression/context.BuildContext`. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, transaction/session behavior, privilege/visibility, concurrency, or request/runtime handling; later history shows follow-up refactors but no evidence of a post-merge bugfix required for this commit.
